column2: A metabolic disorder can prevent the body from turning food into usable energy.
column3: 代謝疾病可能使身體無法把食物轉成可用的能量。
column5: metabolism 的形容詞，跟新陳代謝有關的

column2: Cellular respiration in muscle cells releases energy from glucose and produces carbon dioxide and water.
column3: 肌肉細胞中的細胞呼吸從葡萄糖釋放能量，並產生二氧化碳和水。
column5: re 再 + spir 呼吸，像 spirit，一吸一呼反覆進行

column2: A pond ecosystem depends on the balance among algae, fish, insects, and the water itself.
column3: 池塘生態系取決於藻類、魚、昆蟲與水本身之間的平衡。
column5: eco 家園 + system 系統，大家同住一個家的系統

column2: Tundra is a cold biome with few trees, where the ground stays frozen most of the year.
column3: 苔原是樹木稀少的寒冷生物群系，地面一年中大半時間都結凍。
column5: bio 生命 + ome 整體，一大片同類型的生命區域

column2: Maple trees are deciduous, dropping their bright red leaves every autumn.
column3: 楓樹是落葉性的，每年秋天都會掉落鮮紅的葉子。
column5: de 往下 + cid 落下，葉子一片片掉下來

column2: Pine and fir are coniferous trees that bear cones and keep their needles through winter.
column3: 松樹和冷杉是針葉樹，會結毬果，冬天也保有針葉。
column5: cone 毬果 + fer 帶著，會帶毬果的樹

column2: Holly is an evergreen shrub whose glossy leaves stay bright even in snowy December.
column3: 冬青是常綠灌木，即使在下雪的十二月，光亮的葉子依然翠綠。
column5: ever 永遠 + green 綠色，永遠都是綠的

column2: Sunlight barely reaches the ground because the dense canopy of the rainforest blocks it.
column3: 因為雨林濃密的樹冠層擋住了陽光，陽光幾乎照不到地面。
column5: canopy 像床上的天篷，樹頂撐起一片綠色大傘

column2: Ferns and young saplings grow in the understory, where only dim light filters through.
column3: 蕨類和幼樹長在林下層，那裡只有微弱的光線透進來。
column5: under 下面 + story 樓層，森林的一樓

column2: Fallen leaves and rotting logs cover the forest floor, feeding insects, fungi, and worms.
column3: 落葉和腐木覆蓋著森林地表，餵養昆蟲、真菌和蚯蚓。
column4: cover the forest floor (覆蓋森林地表)
column5: floor 是地板，森林的地板鋪滿了落葉

column2: A venomous snake injects poison through its fangs when it bites its prey.
column3: 毒蛇咬住獵物時，會透過毒牙注入毒液。
column5: venom 是用咬的注入毒液，主動出擊才叫 venomous

column2: Never eat wild mushrooms, because some are poisonous and can make you very sick.
column3: 千萬別吃野生菇類，因為有些有毒，會讓你病得很重。
column5: poison 是吃下肚才中毒，被動的毒；咬人注毒則是 venom

column2: Owls are nocturnal, sleeping all day and hunting only after the sun goes down.
column3: 貓頭鷹是夜行性動物，整天睡覺，太陽下山後才出去獵食。
column5: noct 夜晚，像 nocturne 夜曲，夜晚才活躍

column2: Butterflies are diurnal insects, so you will see them only in daytime sunshine.
column3: 蝴蝶是日行性昆蟲，所以你只會在白天的陽光下看到牠們。
column5: di 日子，像 diary 日記，白天活動的

column2: Deer are crepuscular, grazing at dawn and dusk when the light is soft and dim.
column3: 鹿是晨昏活動的動物，在光線柔和昏暗的黎明與黃昏吃草。
column5: 想成薄如可麗餅 crepe 的晨昏微光，這時才出門

column2: Male robins are fiercely territorial and chase away any rival that enters their garden.
column3: 雄知更鳥領域性很強，會趕走任何闖入花園的對手。
column5: territory 地盤 + ial，死守自家地盤的

column2: Wind assists the dispersal of dandelion seeds, carrying them far from the parent plant.
column3: 風協助蒲公英種子的散播，把它們帶到離母株很遠的地方。
column5: dis 分開 + perse 灑，把種子分開灑出去

column2: A cow is a herbivore, grinding grass and leaves with its flat back teeth.
column3: 牛是草食動物，用扁平的後牙磨碎青草和樹葉。
column5: herb 草本植物 + vore 吃，吃草的動物

column2: The lion is a carnivore that eats only meat, mostly zebras and antelope it has caught.
column3: 獅子是只吃肉的肉食動物，主要吃自己捕到的斑馬和羚羊。
column5: carn 肉，像 chili con carne 墨西哥肉醬，+ vore 吃

column2: Humans are omnivores, so a balanced meal can include vegetables, grains, and meat.
column3: 人類是雜食動物，所以均衡的一餐可以包含蔬菜、穀物和肉。
column4: omnivores eat both (雜食動物葷素都吃)
column5: omni 全部 + vore 吃，什麼都吃

column2: An earthworm is a detritivore, feeding on dead leaves and other bits of decaying matter in the soil.
column3: 蚯蚓是食碎屑生物，以土壤中的落葉和其他腐爛碎屑為食。
column5: detritus 碎屑 + vore 吃，專吃碎屑的清潔工

column2: Warm, wet weather speeds up the decomposition of food scraps in a compost pile.
column3: 溫暖潮濕的天氣加快了堆肥堆中廚餘的分解。
column5: de 分開 + compose 組成，把組成的東西拆開

column2: Bacteria act as decomposers, turning a fallen log into rich soil over many years.
column3: 細菌扮演分解者的角色，經過多年把倒下的木頭變成肥沃的土壤。
column5: decompose 分解 + er 者，大自然的回收員

column2: Fungi such as mushrooms and molds absorb nutrients from the dead plants they grow on.
column3: 蘑菇和黴菌等真菌從所生長的枯死植物中吸收養分。
column5: fun 好玩 + gi，潮濕角落冒出一堆好玩的蘑菇

column2: A single mushroom can release millions of microscopic spores that drift away on the wind.
column3: 一朵蘑菇能釋放數百萬個微小的孢子，隨風飄走。
column5: spore 像 spray 噴灑，一噴出去就長出新菇

column2: Green algae floating on the lake surface produce oxygen, just as land plants do.
column3: 漂浮在湖面的綠藻像陸地植物一樣會產生氧氣。
column5: algae 念「艾吉」，像池塘水面一層綠色毯子

column2: Lichen, a partnership between algae and fungus, grows slowly on bare rock in cold places.
column3: 地衣是藻類與真菌的合作結合體，在寒冷的地方慢慢長在裸岩上。
column4: lichen on rocks (岩石上的地衣)
column5: lichen 念起來像 liken 比喻，一半像藻一半像菌

column2: A soft carpet of moss covered the stones beside the stream in the damp forest.
column3: 柔軟如地毯的苔蘚覆蓋著潮濕森林裡溪邊的石頭。
column5: moss 諧音「貓絲」，像貓咪軟軟的綠毛毯

column2: Ferns and trees are vascular plants, with tube-like tissues that carry water up from the roots.
column3: 蕨類與樹木是維管束植物，具有管狀組織把水從根部往上運送。
column5: vas 容器、管子，像 vase 花瓶和血管 vessel

column2: Water rises through the xylem from the roots to the leaves, much like through a thin straw.
column3: 水經由木質部從根部升到葉片，就像通過一根細吸管。
column5: xylo 是木頭，xylophone 木琴；木頭做的水管

column2: Sugar made in the leaves travels down through the phloem to feed the roots and fruit.
column3: 葉片製造的糖經由韌皮部往下運送，養活根部和果實。
column4: phloem transports sugar (韌皮部運送糖)
column5: phloem 的 phlo 像 flow 流動，糖水往下流

column2: On a hot afternoon, transpiration lets a tree lose hundreds of liters of water through its leaves.
column3: 炎熱的午後，蒸散作用讓一棵樹的葉子散失數百公升的水。
column5: trans 穿過 + spire 呼吸，水氣從葉片呼出去

column2: Tiny stomata on the underside of a leaf open to take in carbon dioxide and let out water vapor.
column3: 葉子背面的微小氣孔會打開，吸入二氧化碳並排出水蒸氣。
column5: stoma 在希臘文是嘴巴，葉子上有無數張小嘴

column2: The epidermis is the thin outer layer of skin that shields the body from dirt and germs.
column3: 表皮是皮膚薄薄的最外層，保護身體不受髒汙和細菌侵害。
column5: epi 在上面 + derm 皮膚，皮膚最上面那一層

column2: A waxy cuticle covers the leaf surface and keeps the plant from drying out.
column3: 蠟質的角質層覆蓋葉面，避免植物乾枯。
column5: cut 像 cutis 皮膚 + icle 小，小小的一層外皮

column2: A turtle can pull its head into its hard carapace whenever danger approaches.
column3: 每當危險靠近時，烏龜就能把頭縮進堅硬的背甲裡。
column5: carapace 諧音「卡拉背司」，背上卡著一個硬殼

column2: A crab's exoskeleton protects its soft body, but it must be shed as the animal grows.
column3: 螃蟹的外骨骼保護柔軟的身體，但隨著成長必須脫掉。
column5: exo 外面 + skeleton 骨骼，骨頭長在身體外面

column2: Unlike insects, a dog has an endoskeleton of bone that grows along with its body.
column3: 與昆蟲不同，狗有骨頭構成的內骨骼，會隨身體一起成長。
column5: endo 內部 + skeleton 骨骼，骨頭藏在身體裡面

column2: Molting birds drop their old feathers in late summer and grow a fresh set before winter.
column3: 換羽期的鳥在夏末脫落舊羽毛，並在冬天前長出一批新的。
column5: molt 像 melt 融化，舊衣服掉了，換上新裝

column2: A caterpillar undergoes complete metamorphosis, changing into a winged butterfly in a few weeks.
column3: 毛毛蟲經歷完全變態，在幾週內變成有翅膀的蝴蝶。
column5: meta 改變 + morph 形狀 + osis 過程，變形記
